name: wagneripjr/wagner-skills-reviewer
description: Forks the default Tessl skill-review rubric with three corrections this repository's documented tradeoffs require: an orchestrator-dispatched worker is scored on its dispatch contract rather than on user-intent keywords, recorded rationale is not counted as padding, and a fenced block quoting a tool's emitted output is credited for fidelity rather than penalised for links that only resolve in the target repository
